EDIT again: This game is the only EA game I've ever bought that actually got fleshed-out to its potential. Amazing game, couldn't recommend it more. 

EDIT: This game is awesome, actively developed, and grown significantly in the last few months. While there still aren't different weapons each class can buy, the level of character customization has been increased dramatically by cosmetics and power upgrades. 10/10 game and its STILL being developed!

TLDR: Not much to unlock, but who cares, the game is beautiful, replayable, and entertaining. 10/10 would desperately kill alien hordes again. Also, don't be an idiot in multiplayer and you wont get kicked (learn how to play your class) -- the players aren't unreasonable, they're just people with a limited amount of time.

I enjoy this game. The basis of the game is a grind to get materials/money in order to upgrade gear for a specific class (There's four equipment/role-differentiated classes). After about 10 hours of gameplay, I've nearly bought every upgrade for the class I've been playing. Considering the costs of upgrades for other classes, I'd estimate that a similar amount of time could be spent maxing the other classes. This situation given, the game contains relatively little unlockable content. I'd like to see new weapons added as the Early Access development proceeds. Despite this customization scarcity, the procedurally generated levels offer engaging and replayable gameplay. On the higher difficulities, swarms can present a real threat and thoughtful teamwork becomes integral to success. So I guess one could hold this game's fledgling nature against it, but even in its current form it's a thrill to shoot swarms of zerging bugs.
This game has more content than Destiny 2 and DLC Cruse Of Osaris Combine.

You go into caves, mine the ♥♥♥♥ out of em, and spray hot-lead at gigantic bugs and 1200 rounds per minute. Not to mention theres all kinds of cosmetics to choose from. So, on a whim 3 friends and I bought this game after looking at it for a month or so. And HOOOOOLY CRAP! The game is an absolute blast! The difficulty settings offer a nice challenge, and the map designs are truly friggin' amazing. The enemy aliens are fun and diverse to fight, each with their own weak point that is absolutley crucial to shoot. Between mining the precious "Morkite" and scrounging around for any "NItra" you can find to keep your team alive, you are being swamped by an impressive amount of enemies. The gameplay is very smooth and rewarding, with fun shooting as well! The classes each have their own role, and you can barley complete a mission without just one of them. I won't go into too much detail into each of the classes (Trying to keep this review semi short); But just know that each class really feels unique. This is one of the few Co-Op games where I actually have to rely on my friend's class to get something done instead of being able to do it myself but slower like in other games. I cannot give this game enough praise and really do hope to see this game garner much more attention in the future. It really is a gem!
